title: Final five-seed run: seven methods + frozen On-Adapter + ablations, original nine-domain L/H table
frozen_at: 2026-10-10, before any seed-5 or seed-6 result is scored and before any new ablation result

seed_sources.2025-2027: existing: seven-method V1 main table (reports/benchmark_textrepair_v1_20261008) and the On-Adapter confirmation (reports/v1conf_20261009; results already known before this plan)

our_method: frozen On-Adapter (cv): VICReg off, epochs 15, CVaR90 loss lambda 0.5, online updates off, backbone-first gate gs 0.9 mu 0 kmin 4, entry seed 100 x seed
primary_statistic: S = geometric mean over 36 tasks of the seed-mean (5 seeds) CVaR90 ratio to iTransformer
secondary_metrics: mean CVaR90 rank over 180 task-seed cells among the 7 methods (ours in place of Original On-Adapter); per-seed S; mean MAE/MSE; tasks better than backbone; tasks >2% worse; worst task ratio; per-domain
ablations: the designs of reports/seed5_final_20261010/ABLATION_PLAN.json (sha256 2d41b239385d9561e106b669e5b28a3d40304c15dbc61f169af20649398e19ac), run on all five seeds; for 2025-2027 the w/o-CVaR variant reuses the confirmation On-Adapter-TA checkpoints; va and e3 are trained with the frozen confirmation package (configs method_comparison_v1conf_{va,e3}_20261010.json)
reporting: all main and ablation results are reported in full; highlights selected afterwards are labelled as selected
test_use: each new test trajectory is computed once; no method change after this plan
